selection_notes: Manual selection of eight commits per project from the newest 80 non-merge commits reachable from each pinned snapshot (git rev-list --date-order --no-merges --max-count=80). Every pool decision is recorded. Sampling tags are hypotheses, never gold labels. This framework/IAM-heavy, historical public sample is development-only and not representative; model pretraining exposure is unknown. Inputs contain selected first-party changed files, not whole commits, and no tests, advisories, release notes or commit messages. Omitted paths are audited. Family grouping is conservative within the included sample; reassess forks/backports before extending the corpus.

django.license_review: First-party Python, CSS and workflow paths only; vendor directories omitted. Retain BSD and bundled Python notices.

flask.license_review: First-party Python and workflow paths; no example assets or third-party code selected.

werkzeug.license_review: First-party Python and workflow paths; debug icons and other bundled assets omitted.

iam.license_review: First-party Terraform module files; no vendored modules. No root NOTICE or additional path licenses found in the source snapshot.
